header.title: How to Clean a Deep Fryer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to thoroughly clean a deep fryer, from initial setup to removing lingering odors and cleaning the exterior.

steps.description: This step involves initial safety precautions and preparing the deep fryer for cleaning, including inspecting and disposing of the oil.
actions: Unplug the deep fryer.
Wrap the connecting wire with a piece of dry cloth.
Inspect the oil inside the fryer.
If the oil is rancid, empty it into a bowl.
Allow the oil to cool.
Pour the cooled oil into a disposal bag.
Pour out the oil from the fryer over the sink.
Remove the basket or filter of the fryer.
steps.part: connecting wire, oil, basket or filter

steps.description: Wipe the inside of the deep fryer with paper towels to remove excess oil residue.
actions: Wipe off traces of oil along the inner surface of the fryer
Spread paper towel sheets within the fryer
Leave paper towel sheets for a few minutes
Remove the oil-soaked paper towels
Repeatedly wipe and mildly scrape the oil crusting in the fryer

steps.description: Clean the deep fryer with a soapy water solution using a sponge, being careful to avoid electrical connections.
actions: Prepare a lukewarm cleaning solution from water and dishwashing soap.
Dip a sponge in the cleaning solution.
Clean the fryer with the soaked sponge.
Ensure that you don’t spill water around the fryer’s outer, electrical connections.

steps.description: Clean the deep fryer filter using high-pressure water or a soft-bristled brush and cleaning solution.
actions: Wash the filter separately with high-pressured water.
Ensure water pressure is not too harsh to avoid damage.
If unsure, wash the filter with a soft-bristled brush.
Use the cleaning solution.

steps.description: This step describes how to remove a deep fryer smell by using a water and vinegar solution.
actions: Prepare a solution containing water and vinegar in a ratio of 1:9
Fill the fryer with this solution
Pour-out the vinegar solution
Rinse the fryer

steps.description: Clean the exterior surface of the deep fryer using a degreaser or baking soda paste to remove any crust or grime.
actions: Apply paste or degreasing compound liberally over the fryer.
Apply the paste using your finger or a paintbrush.
Allow the paste to act upon the grime for about 10 minutes.
Wipe the deep fryer repeatedly with paper towels.
Rinse the deep fryer.
Dry the deep fryer.
